title: Type 2 diabetes follow-up
transcript:
Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Lomidze. How have things been since last time?
Patient: Not bad. I've been taking the metformin, 500 milligrams twice a day. My stomach was upset the first week, but it's fine now.
Doctor: Good. Your HbA1c came back at 8.1, up from 7.6 three months ago.
Patient: I'll be honest, the holidays didn't help.
Doctor: Understandable. Blood pressure today is 138 over 86, weight 94 kilos. Any numbness or tingling in your feet?
Patient: No.
Doctor: Your foot exam looks normal. I'd like to increase the metformin to 1000 milligrams twice a day. I'm also referring you to our dietitian. Keep checking your fasting sugar a few times a week.
Patient: Should I worry about my blood pressure?
Doctor: It's a bit high. We'll recheck it at the next visit before deciding on any treatment. See you in three months with a repeat HbA1c.
